title: Understanding Drainage Pipe Materials and Applications
description: Choosing the correct pipe material is fundamental to the longevity and safety of any drainage network. Different materials handle thermal expansion, structural load, and chemical exposure in distinct ways. This lesson explores the common materials used in residential and commercial drainage systems, comparing their structural properties, joining methods, and typical application environments. By understanding the physical characteristics of each material, plumbing professionals can select the appropriate piping that complies with local building codes and stands up to long-term service demands.
